flora: Mature Oak-like trees (gnarled, spreading branches, massive rugged trunks)
Understory shrubs and early flowering plants
Low herbaceous ferns as ground cover
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; gnarled and ancient tree silhouettes; emphasizing a stable, leafy forest floor; clear use of the Hell Creek mineral palette.

visual_logic.composition: A wide-angle view of a gnarled oak-like forest. The massive trunks are spaced out, allowing light to hit a forest floor covered in brown leaves and patches of forest-green moss. The background shows a dense, lush canopy.
visual_logic.ground: A rich floor of dark brown organic soil and fallen grey-brown leaves.
visual_logic.lighting: Warm, direct cinematic sunlight breaking through the canopy, creating strong 'god rays' and highlighting the texture of the gnarled branches.
